Definition: Jehoshaphat, the name of six Israelites; also of a valley near Jerusalem
BiblicalUsage: Jehoshaphat is the name of six Israelites, and of a valley near Jerusalem. In 2 Samuel 8:16, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder. The fuller story is told on the King Jehoshaphat profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jehoshaphat matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
